scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const { execFileSync } = require('child_process'); function walk(d) { return fs.existsSync(d) ? fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(path.join(d, e.name)) : e.name.endsWith('.js') ? [path.join(d, e.name)] : []) : []; } const files = [...walk('src'), ...walk('tests')]; files.forEach(f => execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f])); console.log('Syntax check passed for ' + files.length + ' backend files.');"
